rationale: Single PKZMSA 2022-2026 PDF: high-value dated transposition register but a one-off artifact; monitor the parent portal for successors.
Assembly EU-integration committee page yields acquis-compatibility opinions on banking bills; URL check failed so re-verify liveness.
EEAS Kosovo hub is a durable multilingual entry point to SAA bodies and Growth Plan announcements.
Standalone EU enlargement aggregator usable as a change-detection tripwire for Reform Agenda/IPA items.
Outreach portal with mostly explainer content; value limited to local-language terminology and secondary alerts.
Bilingual RFE/RL feed gives timely reporting on EU measures affecting Kosovo's financial rule pipeline.
Single mirrored country-report PDF; useful stable fallback copy, not a producing source.
Ministry department sub-page on rks-gov.net with many siblings; covered by monitoring the ministry/government parent.
IMF Kosovo country hub aggregates Article IV, programme reviews and TA outputs; failed check is soft only.
Specific Article IV report: strong evidence on CBK supervisory reform timelines; the series is caught via the IMF hub.
FSSR follow-up TA report is the most detailed forward calendar of supervisory reform; a single dated artifact.
SBA/RSF review document carries hard-dated structural benchmarks for CBK/MoF; one-off artifact of a monitored series.
IMF eLibrary is a durable, citable archive with stable per-issue URLs for systematic harvesting and back-fill.
Single PIMA TA PDF with fiscal-governance focus; only contextual relevance to banking/payments rulemaking.
World Bank Documents & Reports is a searchable standalone archive of Kosovo financial-sector conditionality documents.
Financial Sector Development Project appraisal PDF is a dated roadmap for the fast payment system and development bank.
Live filtered project register for Kosovo gives earliest signal of new financial-sector conditionality.
FinSAC unit page keeps producing supervision/resolution advisory outputs relevant to Kosovo; failed check is soft.
IEG country programme evaluation approach paper: one-off retrospective on slipped financial-sector conditionality.
Systematic Country Diagnostic PDF provides baseline payments/access-to-finance analytics behind later targets.
Open Knowledge Repository offers machine-accessible (OAI-PMH/REST) bulk harvesting of Bank analytical outputs.
Board-approved Kosovo country strategy PDF signalling EBRD financial-sector policy-dialogue priorities.
Sector strategy document front-runs country conditionality but is a periodic one-off publication.
Annual Kosovo transition assessment gives a reliable dated timeline of financial-sector legislative milestones.
Private-sector diagnostic PDF supplies the constraints evidence base behind EBRD's legal-reform asks.
EBRD news feed continuously announces facilities and TA components for Kosovo banks; durable monitoring target.
EIB Kosovo project register keeps producing appraisal pages for intermediated financial-sector operations.
